Name: Simple Slime Hutch Recolor
Author: holychurros
Description:
This is literally a basic exterior Slime Hutch recolor! I will do an interior soon, but I'm still learning a few things about the map before I tackle that. 

You can keep this mod EXACTLY like it is, and if you have nothing else modifying the Slime Hutch, you're good to go!

If you'd like to use this in lieu of another Slime Hutch mod in a different mod pack - and understand how to switch it all out - feel free! I obviously don't mind at all!

If you have questions on how to do that, because I personally mix and match all the time! I'd love to help any newbie modders, so feel free to ask any questions about it!

Let me know if there are any questions or requests on other stone colors that would look good!

Best... [b]HOLYCHURROS, BATMAN![/b]
